# HANDS & HEAD

> One Core, Many Worlds. Central OS Hub uniting browser-native WebGL2 AI cinema software, direct-from-source Dhaka B2B industrial manufacturing, and a 24-module venture ecosystem founded by Rakib Himon (Shaikh Rakibuzzaman Himon).

- Master Entity ID: https://handsandhead.com/#organization
- Canonical Central OS Hub: https://handsandhead.com/
- Industrial & B2B Export Engine: https://b2b.handsandhead.com/
- Flagship WebGL2 AI Video & Storyboard Platform: https://storyboard.handsandhead.com/
- Founder & Systems Architect: Rakib Himon (Shaikh Rakibuzzaman Himon) — https://rakib.handsandhead.com/
- Headquarters: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Last Updated: 2026-11-23
- Complete Fact-Sheet: https://handsandhead.com/llms-full.txt
- XML Sitemap: https://handsandhead.com/sitemap.xml

## Three Core Ecosystem Pillars

1. **[Central OS Hub — HANDS & HEAD Master OS](https://handsandhead.com/)**: Zero-latency 3-tab operating system (`#home`, `#apps`, `#sliders`) orchestrating 24 modular portals, the RAWx 16 Ultra Sliders kinetic interface lab, and real-time multi-device task sync.
2. **[Industrial & B2B Export Engine — HANDS & HEAD B2B](https://b2b.handsandhead.com/)**: Direct-from-source Dhaka, Bangladesh manufacturing house offering **120 pcs/style MOQ**, **240–300 GSM combed cotton** heavyweight streetwear, **genuine distressed full-grain leather**, custom outerwear jackets, golden jute, intimates, and surgical-grade **316L/516SS stainless steel hardware** under **RAWx** and **Arutemika**.
3. **[Flagship Tech Engine — HandFilm Studio & Storyboard](https://storyboard.handsandhead.com/)**: Browser-native **WebGL2 GPU shader** AI video editor, non-linear editor (NLE), cinema player, and **Cloudflare Workers / Stream** video hosting platform.

## Verified Technical & Manufacturing Fact-Sheet

- **Apparel & Streetwear MOQ**: 120 pcs/style direct-from-source in Dhaka, Bangladesh (startup-friendly small-batch to bulk export scaling).
- **Fabric Weight & Grade**: 240–300 GSM combed cotton French terry, heavyweight jersey, and custom knitted fleece.
- **Leather & Outerwear**: Audited Dhaka tanneries producing genuine distressed full-grain leather jackets, bags, belts, and structured coats.
- **Metal Hardware**: Precision-milled surgical-grade **316L and 516SS stainless steel** bracelets, custom clasps, and industrial apparel fittings (RAWx wing).
- **Video & Web Architecture**: Zero-install **WebGL2 GPU shaders**, real-time color grading & compositing, **Cloudflare Workers** edge routing, and 60fps React + TypeScript SPA performance.

## Complete 24-Module Ecosystem Directory

### Commerce
- [01. D2C SHOP](https://d2c.handsandhead.com/): Small-batch genuine distressed leather, 240–300 GSM heavyweight streetwear, and 316L hardware drops.
- [02. ARUTEMIKA](https://arutemika.handsandhead.com/): Corporate, wholesale, and precision craft apparel & leather procurement desk.

### Content & Cinema
- [03. ARTICLES](https://articles.handsandhead.com/): Technical essays on WebGL2 systems, Dhaka manufacturing economics, and design realism.
- [04. STUDIO (HandFilm)](https://storyboard.handsandhead.com/): HandFilm Studio & Storyboard — WebGL2 GPU shader AI video editor, NLE, cinema player, and Cloudflare Workers video host.
- [05. AURAL](https://aural.handsandhead.com/): Procedural Web Audio soundscapes, acoustic engineering, and ambient music lab.

### Manufacturing Wings (Dhaka Direct-from-Source)
- [06. TEXTILE](https://b2b.handsandhead.com/#textile): Direct-from-source Bangladesh fabric mills, custom knitted fleece, and 240–300 GSM combed cotton.
- [07. RMG](https://b2b.handsandhead.com/#rmg): Dhaka cut-and-sew RMG production with 120 pcs/style MOQ for 240–300 GSM heavyweight streetwear and hoodies.
- [08. LEATHER](https://b2b.handsandhead.com/#leather): Audited Dhaka tannery sourcing and genuine distressed full-grain leather bags, belts, and accessories.
- [09. JACKET](https://jacket.handsandhead.com/): Custom distressed leather jackets, heavyweight bombers, and technical outerwear production.
- [10. JUTE](https://b2b.handsandhead.com/#jute): Export-grade Bangladesh golden jute fabrics, structural textiles, and zero-carbon eco-packaging.
- [11. LINGERIE](https://b2b.handsandhead.com/#lingerie): Precision-stitched intimates, technical loungewear, and private-label lingerie manufacturing.
- [12. BRACELETS (RAWx)](https://rawx.handsandhead.com/): RAWx surgical-grade 316L and 516SS stainless steel bracelets, custom clasps, and industrial metal hardware.

### Lifestyle
- [13. BLOOM](https://bloom.handsandhead.com/): Botanical design studio, organic aesthetics, and tactile lifestyle systems.
- [14. GYM](https://gym.handsandhead.com/): Strength conditioning frameworks, athletic apparel engineering, and wellness systems.

### Agriculture & Food
- [15. AGRO](https://agro.handsandhead.com/): Traceable direct-source Bangladesh agricultural supply chain and crop ventures.
- [16. FOOD](https://food.handsandhead.com/): Specialty culinary craft, packaged provisions, and modern food brand incubation.

### Software & Apps
- [17. BLOOM APP](https://bloomapp.handsandhead.com/): Digital botanical concierge and lifestyle ritual companion web app.
- [18. APPS (Skyhara)](https://apps.handsandhead.com/): Zero-bloat browser utilities, micro-software directory, and ecosystem ventures including Skyhara.
- [19. NOTE](https://note.handsandhead.com/): Encrypted local-first Markdown capture and distraction-free thinking workspace.
- [20. PICSEED](https://picseed.handsandhead.com/): High-velocity visual reference library, frame curation, and image CDN pipeline.
- [21. HUB](https://hub.handsandhead.com/): Central routing spine and telemetry gateway connecting all HANDS & HEAD portals.
- [22. DEEPER](https://deeper.handsandhead.com/): Frontier R&D archive, deep research indexing, and experimental WebGL interface prototypes.
- [23. HIYA](https://hiya.handsandhead.com/): Low-latency peer-to-peer cultural & team communication portal.
- [24. ME (Rakib Himon)](https://rakib.handsandhead.com/): Founder enclave and systems architecture profile of Rakib Himon (Shaikh Rakibuzzaman Himon).
